notes.title: Season 3 Update!
notes.content:
Fellow Animal leaders!
The S3 season kicks off on October 1st!
Thank you for your love of our game, and in order to bridge the gap between steam players and players on other platforms due to the launch time of the game, we will replace the previous season's qualifying awards for heads.
Here are some of the in-game changes:
1. Text description optimization of some animals and props

2. Some skin can be purchased without restriction

3. Fix the text overflow display problem in some interfaces
